title: Resend (mail)
description: Resend as gohort's mail, in place of an SMTP server: an API that sends from a domain you verify. Declared as a service you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Create an API key at resend.com/api-keys and verify your sending domain under Domains. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which sends a short test email to the test recipient. Then pick it under Admin > System > Mail (SMTP) as Send with: signup approvals, reports, alerts and the send_email tool go through it. A From Address set there is used in place of the one given here. No price is declared, as it depends on your plan: add a per_call cost to the connector's spec to see what mail costs.

questions.name: api_key
questions.label: Resend API key
questions.help: Starts re_. Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the mail settings list it by this name.

questions.name: from
questions.label: Send from
questions.help: An address on a domain you have verified with the service, e.g. gohort@yourdomain.example.

questions.name: to
questions.label: Test recipient
questions.help: Where the connector's Test sends its test email.
